LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT

                                     OF

                     ⟦name|ROSALIND MEI-LING TREMBLAY-CHAN⟧

I, ⟦name|ROSALIND MEI-LING TREMBLAY-CHAN⟧, of the City of Hamilton, in the Province of Ontario, declare that this is my last Will and Testament.

1.  REVOCATION
I revoke all wills and codicils previously made by me.

2.  APPOINTMENT OF ESTATE TRUSTEE
I appoint my husband, ⟦name|BERNARD JOSEPH TREMBLAY⟧, to be the sole Estate Trustee of this my Will. If my husband dies before me, or dies before the trusts in this Will are fully performed, or is unable or unwilling to act or to continue to act, I appoint my sister, ⟦name|VIVIAN CHAN-OSEI⟧, of the City of Mississauga, and my friend, ⟦name|MAHENDRA RAGHUBIR⟧ (known to my family as "⟦name|Manny⟧"), of the Town of Ancaster, both in the Province of Ontario, to be the Estate Trustees of this my Will in his place. In this Will the expression "my Trustees" means the estate trustee or estate trustees acting from time to time.

3.  GUARDIAN
If my husband dies before me, or is unable to act, I appoint my sister ⟦name|VIVIAN⟧ to be the guardian of the persons of my minor children, namely my daughter ⟦name|ÉLODIE GRACE TREMBLAY-CHAN⟧ (born ⟦date of birth|June 14, 2013⟧) and my son ⟦name|THEO HENRY TREMBLAY-CHAN⟧ (born ⟦date of birth|February 2, 2017⟧), during their minority.

4.  SPECIFIC GIFTS
I direct my Trustees to deliver or pay:
(a)  to my son ⟦name|THEO⟧, if he survives me, my Edmonton Oilers jersey autographed by Wayne Gretzky and the collection of Hamilton Tiger-Cats programmes assembled by my late father, ⟦name|HENRY CHAN⟧;
(b)  to my daughter ⟦name|ÉLODIE⟧, if she survives me, my jade bangle, my grandmother's upright piano and all of my sheet music;
(c)  to ⟦name|MAHENDRA RAGHUBIR⟧, if he survives me, the sum of FIVE THOUSAND DOLLARS ($5,000.00), in gratitude for his friendship;
(d)  to the HAMILTON PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION (charitable registration number 11904 3352 RR0001), the sum of TEN THOUSAND DOLLARS ($10,000.00), to be used for its children's literacy programs.

5.  REGISTERED PLANS AND DESIGNATIONS
(a)  I confirm the designation of my husband as successor holder of my Tax-Free Savings Account at Meridian Credit Union Limited, account number ⟦account number|0447-3318-209⟧, and nothing in this Will revokes that designation.
(b)  I confirm the designation of my children, in equal shares, as beneficiaries of my group life insurance under Sun Life policy no. ⟦account number|GL 207714-03⟧ provided through my employer, McMaster University, and I declare that the share of any child under the age of twenty-five (25) years shall be held by my Trustees under paragraph 7.

6.  RESIDUE
I give the residue of my estate to my husband if he survives me by thirty (30) days. If he does not, I give the residue in equal shares to those of my children who survive me, subject to paragraph 7.

7.  BENEFICIARIES UNDER TWENTY-FIVE
If any person becomes entitled to any share of my estate before attaining the age of twenty-five (25) years, my Trustees shall hold that share in trust and may pay so much of the income and capital as they consider advisable for that person's support, education and benefit until that person reaches that age.

8.  EXCLUSION FROM NET FAMILY PROPERTY
Any property that a beneficiary receives under this Will, and any income from it, shall be excluded from that beneficiary's net family property within the meaning of the Family Law Act (Ontario).

IN WITNESS WHEREOF I have signed this Will, consisting of these four (4) pages, at the City of Hamilton, Ontario, on March 3, 2026.

SIGNED by the testator, ⟦name|ROSALIND MEI-LING TREMBLAY-CHAN⟧, in our presence, and we, at her request, in her presence and in the presence of each other, have signed our names as witnesses.

On the tax question: if a creditor ever sends you a 1099-C for one of these accounts, dispute it with the creditor and keep your FTC report and police case number.
